CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2577 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 9720cda1ebc3cb8304e62b5914910d54642e721a. Bus nonce: d3803cc7cf2822cfe769b96a8fbf532e. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 9720cda1ebc3cb8304e62b5914910d54642e721a`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 9720cda1ebc3cb8304e62b5914910d54642e721a` or `Fix review: blocked 9720cda1ebc3cb8304e62b5914910d54642e721a <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: d3803cc7cf2822cfe769b96a8fbf532e`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `9720cda1ebc3cb8304e62b5914910d54642e721a` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2577 9720cda1ebc3cb8304e62b5914910d54642e721a") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2577-d3803cc7`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Fix reviewer for PR #2577 (group R10-FLOW-DISPATCH, topic r10-flow-dispatch) at head 9720cda1ebc3cb8304e62b5914910d54642e721a, after fixer round fix2577z on the blocked verdict at 1060a1f035db0bb84263080ec4b36343a742c870 (harness: class-open, --group drops flags). Read every open block with `git fetch origin review/2577; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` and confirm each is cleared at this head; check what changed with git diff 1060a1f035db0bb84263080ec4b36343a742c870...9720cda1ebc3cb8304e62b5914910d54642e721a.
Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at that head, with the finder's harness the group brief names (roster: origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster, read with jq), never the fixer's. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- Mutation proof yourself: every pass-through the --group CLI forwards (--role, --pr, --nonce, --group, --model and any other flag) mutated must turn a test red; confirm the body states an enumeration rule for the class and that you find no sibling flag it misses.
- The finder's harness at both ends; a null control for every quantified claim.
- Re-measure every figure in the PR body at this head; report each as re-derived or not re-derivable.
- carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check over the body reports 0 unrouted; every Carry in your own verdict names a live group (stage not done).
- ## Red checks: read the check-runs API per commit at this head (nightly-status grades main; main's ci-ratchet red is runner-speed variance owned by R10-CI-LAYOUT).
- git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 9720cda1ebc3cb8304e62b5914910d54642e721a must be clean; do not ask for a main absorb on a clean head.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full 40-hex head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: d3803cc7cf2822cfe769b96a8fbf532e.
